propositions: Attestation staleness messages currently name a fixed list (description/AC/file_impact/children) that does not match the actual basis components and does not indicate which component actually changed.
Ticking acceptance criteria checkboxes does not invalidate attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material fingerprint via _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing.

Per-component fingerprints must be sourced from the signed manifest rather than reconstructed at read time, because children is derived from other tickets' state and would require replaying the event store.

The plan-review system must report component-specific staleness reasons (e.g., 'description (4210 -> 4396 chars), children (3 -> 4)') instead of a generic list, and extend this attribution to all attestation refusal surfaces including stale-reopened, unsigned gates, and dependency changes.

Pre-330c attestations with raw-description basis cannot be distinguished from current normalized hashes without per-component records, requiring a fallback mechanism that uses signed child-id pins or reports the component indeterminately.
